column2:
ecological(adj.)生態的、生態學的
ecology(n.)生態
ecologist(n.)生態學家
ecological balance 生態平衡
ecological disaster 生態浩劫
Cutting down too many trees can upset the ecological balance of a region.
(砍伐過多樹木會破壞一個地區的生態平衡。)
The oil spill was described as an ecological disaster for the coastline.
(這起漏油事件被形容為海岸線的一場生態浩劫。)

ecology(n.)生態、生態學
ecological(adj.)生態的
ecologist(n.)生態學家
marine ecology 海洋生態
the ecology of 的生態
She plans to study marine ecology at a university in Taiwan.
(她打算在台灣的大學研究海洋生態。)
Building the new road could seriously damage the ecology of the wetland.
(興建新道路可能會嚴重破壞濕地的生態。)

ecosystem(n.)生態系統
(無詞性變化)
marine ecosystem 海洋生態系
fragile ecosystem 脆弱的生態系統
Coral reefs are among the most diverse ecosystems on Earth.
(珊瑚礁是地球上最多樣化的生態系統之一。)
Introducing foreign species can harm a fragile ecosystem.
(引進外來物種可能會危害脆弱的生態系統。)

ego(n.)自我、自尊心、自負
egoism(n.)自我中心
boost one's ego 增強自信、滿足虛榮心
a big ego 自負、自我膨脹
Winning the award gave his ego a big boost.
(得獎讓他的自尊心大大提升。)
It's hard to work with someone who has such a big ego.
(和一個那麼自負的人共事很困難。)

elaborate(adj./v.)精心製作的、詳盡的、詳細說明
elaboration(n.)詳盡說明
elaborate on 詳細說明…
an elaborate plan 精心策劃的計畫
Could you elaborate on your idea a little more?
(你可以再詳細說明一下你的想法嗎？)
The students prepared an elaborate costume for the school play.
(學生們為校園話劇準備了一套精心製作的服裝。)

eligible(adj.)有資格的、合格的
eligibility(n.)資格
be eligible for 有資格獲得…
be eligible to vote 有投票資格
Students with good grades are eligible for the scholarship.
(成績優良的學生有資格申請這項獎學金。)
In Taiwan, citizens over the age of 18 are eligible to vote in referendums.
(在台灣，年滿十八歲的公民有資格在公投中投票。)

eloquent(adj.)雄辯的、有說服力的、口才好的
eloquence(n.)口才、雄辯
eloquently(adv.)雄辯地
an eloquent speaker 口才很好的講者
an eloquent speech 動人的演說
The eloquent speaker kept the audience's attention for an hour.
(那位口才極好的講者吸引聽眾注意力長達一小時。)
Her eloquent speech persuaded many people to donate money.
(她動人的演說說服了許多人捐款。)

embrace(v./n.)擁抱、欣然接受、包含
(無詞性變化)
embrace change 擁抱改變
a warm embrace 溫暖的擁抱
Young people tend to embrace new technology quickly.
(年輕人往往很快就接受新科技。)
The mother held her son in a warm embrace at the airport.
(母親在機場給了兒子一個溫暖的擁抱。)

emission(n.)排放、排放物
emit(v.)排放、散發
carbon emissions 碳排放
reduce emissions 減少排放
Many countries have promised to reduce carbon emissions by 2050.
(許多國家已承諾在2050年前減少碳排放。)
Electric cars produce no exhaust emissions while driving.
(電動車行駛時不會產生廢氣排放。)

endorse(v.)支持、贊同、代言、背書、endorsement(n.)支持、代言
(無詞性變化)
celebrity endorsement 名人代言
endorse a product 為產品代言
The famous athlete was paid millions to endorse the sports shoes.
(那位知名運動員收了數百萬元為這款運動鞋代言。)
The plan won the endorsement of most teachers and parents.
(這項計畫獲得了大多數老師和家長的支持。)

enterprise(n.)企業、事業、進取心
enterprising(adj.)有進取心的
private enterprise 私人企業
small and medium enterprises 中小企業
Small and medium enterprises play an important role in Taiwan's economy.
(中小企業在台灣經濟中扮演重要角色。)
Starting her own bakery was a risky enterprise.
(開自己的麵包店是一項有風險的事業。)

enthusiastic(adj.)熱心的、熱情的
enthusiasm(n.)熱忱
enthusiastically(adv.)熱情地
be enthusiastic about 對…熱衷
an enthusiastic welcome 熱烈的歡迎
He is very enthusiastic about joining the school's robotics club.
(他非常熱衷於加入學校的機器人社。)
The exchange students received an enthusiastic welcome from our class.
(交換學生受到我們班熱烈的歡迎。)

entitle(v.)給…權利、使有資格、給…命名
entitlement(n.)權利
be entitled to 有權…
a book entitled 一本名為…的書
All employees are entitled to two weeks of paid vacation.
(所有員工都有權享有兩週的帶薪假。)
She wrote a book entitled 'Growing Up in Taipei'.
(她寫了一本名為《在台北長大》的書。)

entity(n.)實體、存在物
(無詞性變化)
legal entity 法人
separate entity 獨立的個體
The two companies merged but remain separate legal entities.
(這兩家公司合併了，但仍是各自獨立的法人。)
The school library operates as a separate entity from the main office.
(學校圖書館是獨立於行政辦公室的單位。)

entrepreneur(n.)企業家、創業者
entrepreneurial(adj.)有創業精神的
entrepreneurship(n.)創業精神
young entrepreneur 年輕創業家
successful entrepreneur 成功的企業家
The young entrepreneur started her online business while still in college.
(這位年輕創業家在大學時期就開始經營網路生意。)
Many successful entrepreneurs failed several times before they succeeded.
(許多成功的企業家在成功之前都失敗過好幾次。)

envious(adj.)羨慕的、嫉妒的
envy(n./v.)羨慕、嫉妒
be envious of 羨慕…
envious eyes 羨慕的眼光
Many classmates were envious of her perfect test scores.
(許多同學都很羨慕她完美的考試成績。)
He looked at his friend's new bike with envious eyes.
(他用羨慕的眼光看著朋友的新腳踏車。)

envision(v.)想像、展望、預想
vision(n.)願景、視力
envision a future 展望未來
envision doing 設想做…
The mayor envisions a city where everyone can ride bikes safely.
(市長展望一個人人都能安全騎腳踏車的城市。)
I never envisioned myself becoming a teacher.
(我從沒想過自己會成為一名老師。)

epidemic(n./adj.)流行病、傳染病、流行的
(無詞性變化)
flu epidemic 流感疫情
an epidemic of 某事的大量蔓延
The government took quick action to stop the flu epidemic.
(政府迅速採取行動遏止流感疫情。)
Some experts say there is an epidemic of loneliness among young people.
(有些專家說孤獨感正在年輕人之間蔓延。)

episode(n.)(連續劇)一集、插曲、一段經歷
(無詞性變化)
the latest episode 最新一集
an unpleasant episode 不愉快的經歷
I can't wait to watch the latest episode of the drama tonight.
(我等不及今晚要看這部連續劇的最新一集。)
She wanted to forget that embarrassing episode in junior high school.
(她想忘掉國中時那段尷尬的經歷。)

equation(n.)方程式、等式、綜合考量
equate(v.)把…視為同等
solve an equation 解方程式
the other side of the equation 問題的另一面
The students learned how to solve equations with two unknowns.
(學生們學習如何解二元方程式。)
Money is only one part of the equation when choosing a job.
(選擇工作時，薪水只是考量的一部分。)

equity(n.)公平、公正、股權
equitable(adj.)公平的
gender equity 性別平等
educational equity 教育公平
The government is working to improve educational equity in rural areas.
(政府正努力提升偏鄉地區的教育公平。)
Gender equity in the workplace is still a goal for many countries.
(職場的性別平等仍是許多國家努力的目標。)

equivalent(n./adj.)相等物、對等詞、相等的
equivalence(n.)相等
be equivalent to 相當於…
the equivalent of 相當於…的東西
One U.S. dollar is roughly equivalent to thirty New Taiwan dollars.
(一美元大約相當於三十元新台幣。)
There is no exact English equivalent for this Chinese idiom.
(這句中文成語沒有完全對等的英文說法。)

erect(v./adj.)豎立、建造、直立的
erection(n.)建造、豎立
erect a statue 豎立雕像
stand erect 挺直站立
The city erected a statue in honor of the brave firefighters.
(市政府豎立了一座雕像來紀念英勇的消防員。)
The soldiers stood erect as the national anthem was played.
(播放國歌時，士兵們挺直站立。)

errand(n.)差事、跑腿
(無詞性變化)
run errands 跑腿、辦雜事
on an errand 外出辦事
I have to run some errands for my mom after school.
(放學後我得幫我媽媽跑腿辦點事。)
My father went out on an errand and will be back soon.
(我爸爸出門辦事了，很快就回來。)

erupt(v.)(火山)爆發、突然發生
eruption(n.)爆發
volcano erupts 火山爆發
erupt into 突然爆發成…
The volcano erupted suddenly, forcing thousands of people to leave.
(火山突然爆發，迫使數千人撤離。)
The crowd erupted into cheers when the team scored the winning goal.
(球隊踢進致勝球時，群眾爆出歡呼聲。)

escalator(n.)電扶梯
escalate(v.)逐步升級
take the escalator 搭電扶梯
stand on the right of the escalator 站在電扶梯右側
In Taipei MRT stations, people usually stand on the right side of the escalator.
(在台北捷運站，人們通常站在電扶梯的右側。)
Please hold the handrail when you take the escalator.
(搭電扶梯時請握緊扶手。)

essence(n.)本質、精髓、精華
essential(adj.)必要的、本質的
in essence 本質上
the essence of 的精髓
In essence, the two plans are almost the same.
(本質上，這兩個計畫幾乎一樣。)
Kindness is the essence of true friendship.
(善良是真正友誼的精髓。)

estate(n.)地產、財產、莊園
(無詞性變化)
real estate 房地產
estate agent 房屋仲介
Real estate prices in Taipei are among the highest in Taiwan.
(台北的房地產價格是全台最高之一。)
The old man left his entire estate to his only grandson.
(那位老人把所有財產都留給了他唯一的孫子。)

eternal(adj.)永恆的、永遠的
eternity(n.)永恆
eternally(adv.)永遠地
eternal love 永恆的愛
eternal life 永生
The couple promised each other eternal love on their wedding day.
(這對新人在婚禮上互許永恆的愛。)
The poem describes the eternal beauty of nature.
(這首詩描寫大自然永恆的美。)

ethic(n.)倫理、道德觀
ethics(n.)倫理學、道德規範
ethical(adj.)道德的
work ethic 職業道德、敬業精神
medical ethics 醫學倫理
Her strong work ethic earned her a quick promotion.
(她強烈的敬業精神讓她很快就升遷了。)
The use of AI in schools raises many questions about ethics.
(在學校使用人工智慧引發了許多倫理問題。)

ethical(adj.)道德的、倫理的、合乎道德的
ethics(n.)倫理
ethically(adv.)合乎道德地
ethical issue 倫理議題
ethical behavior 合乎道德的行為
Cloning humans raises serious ethical issues.
(複製人引發了嚴重的倫理議題。)
Many consumers prefer to buy from companies with ethical practices.
(許多消費者偏好向經營合乎道德的公司購買商品。)

evolution(n.)演化、進化、發展
evolve(v.)演化
evolutionary(adj.)演化的
the theory of evolution 演化論
the evolution of 的發展
Darwin is famous for his theory of evolution.
(達爾文以他的演化論聞名。)
The museum shows the evolution of the telephone over the past century.
(這間博物館展示了過去一世紀以來電話的演變。)

evolve(v.)演化、逐步發展
evolution(n.)演化
evolve from 從…演化而來
evolve into 發展成…
Scientists believe that birds evolved from dinosaurs.
(科學家相信鳥類是從恐龍演化而來的。)
Their small online shop has evolved into a large company.
(他們的小網店已經發展成一家大公司。)

exaggeration(n.)誇張、誇大
exaggerate(v.)誇張、誇大
without exaggeration 毫不誇張地說
a slight exaggeration 有點誇張
It is no exaggeration to say that he is the best player on the team.
(毫不誇張地說，他是隊上最好的球員。)
Saying the test was impossible is a bit of an exaggeration.
(說這次考試根本不可能考好，有點誇張了。)

exceed(v.)超過、超出
excess(n.)過量
excessive(adj.)過度的
exceed the speed limit 超速
exceed expectations 超出預期
Drivers who exceed the speed limit will be fined.
(超速的駕駛人將會被罰款。)
The results of the experiment exceeded our expectations.
(實驗結果超出了我們的預期。)

exceptional(adj.)傑出的、優秀的、例外的
exception(n.)例外
exceptionally(adv.)特別地、異常地
exceptional talent 過人的天賦
exceptional circumstances 特殊情況
The young violinist showed exceptional talent at an early age.
(那位年輕小提琴家從小就展現出過人的天賦。)
Late homework will only be accepted in exceptional circumstances.
(只有在特殊情況下才會接受遲交的作業。)

excessive(adj.)過度的、過多的
excess(n.)過量
excessively(adv.)過度地
excessive use 過度使用
excessive drinking 過度飲酒
Excessive use of smartphones may harm your eyesight.
(過度使用智慧型手機可能會損害視力。)
The restaurant charged an excessive price for a simple bowl of noodles.
(那家餐廳一碗簡單的麵卻收取過高的價格。)

exclaim(v.)驚叫、呼喊
exclamation(n.)驚嘆、感嘆詞
exclaim in surprise 驚訝地叫出來
exclamation mark 驚嘆號
'What a beautiful view!' she exclaimed when she reached the top of the mountain.
(她登上山頂時驚呼：「好美的景色！」)
The children exclaimed in delight when they saw the snow.
(孩子們看到雪時開心地大叫。)

exclude(v.)排除、不包括
exclusion(n.)排除
exclusive(adj.)獨有的
be excluded from 被排除在…之外
excluding tax 不含稅
No student should be excluded from school activities because of their background.
(任何學生都不應因為背景而被排除在學校活動之外。)
The price of the hotel room is three thousand dollars, excluding tax.
(這間飯店房間的價格是三千元，不含稅。)

exclusive(adj.)獨有的、獨家的、高級的
exclusively(adv.)專門地、獨家地
exclude(v.)排除
exclusive interview 獨家專訪
mutually exclusive 互相排斥的
The magazine published an exclusive interview with the famous director.
(那本雜誌刊登了對這位知名導演的獨家專訪。)
Studying hard and having fun are not mutually exclusive.
(用功讀書和享受樂趣並不互相衝突。)

execute(v.)執行、實行、處決
execution(n.)執行、處決
executive(n.)主管
execute a plan 執行計畫
be executed for 因…被處決
The team executed the plan perfectly and won the game.
(球隊完美執行計畫並贏得比賽。)
In the past, people could be executed for stealing bread.
(在過去，偷麵包的人可能會被處決。)

execution(n.)執行、實施、死刑
execute(v.)執行、處決
executioner(n.)行刑者
the execution of a plan 計畫的執行
public execution 公開處決
Good ideas are useless without careful execution.
(好點子若沒有周詳的執行就毫無用處。)
Public executions were common in Europe hundreds of years ago.
(幾百年前，公開處決在歐洲很常見。)

executive(n./adj.)主管、行政官、執行的、行政的
execute(v.)執行
chief executive officer (CEO) 執行長
executive power 行政權
She became the chief executive officer of the company at age thirty-five.
(她三十五歲時就成為了這家公司的執行長。)
The Executive Yuan is responsible for carrying out government policies.
(行政院負責執行政府政策。)

exile(n./v.)流亡、放逐、流亡者、流放
(無詞性變化)
in exile 流亡中
be exiled to 被流放到…
The writer lived in exile for twenty years before returning home.
(那位作家流亡了二十年才回到故鄉。)
Napoleon was exiled to a small island in the Atlantic Ocean.
(拿破崙被流放到大西洋上的一座小島。)

exotic(adj./n.)異國風情的、外來的、外來品種
(無詞性變化)
exotic food 異國料理
exotic species 外來物種
We tried some exotic food at the night market, like crocodile meat.
(我們在夜市嘗試了一些異國食物，例如鱷魚肉。)
Exotic species can be a serious threat to local wildlife.
(外來物種可能對當地野生動物造成嚴重威脅。)

expedition(n.)遠征、探險、探險隊
(無詞性變化)
go on an expedition 去探險
a scientific expedition 科學考察
The team went on an expedition to the South Pole last winter.
(這支隊伍去年冬天前往南極探險。)
The scientific expedition discovered several new kinds of plants.
(這次科學考察發現了好幾種新的植物。)

expertise(n.)專業知識、專長
expert(n./adj.)專家、熟練的
technical expertise 技術專長
lack the expertise 缺乏專業知識
The project needs someone with expertise in computer programming.
(這個專案需要具備電腦程式設計專長的人。)
We lack the expertise to repair the machine ourselves.
(我們缺乏自己修理這台機器的專業知識。)

explicit(adj.)明確的、清楚的、露骨的
explicitly(adv.)明確地
explicit instructions 明確的指示
explicit content 露骨的內容
The teacher gave us explicit instructions about the project.
(老師給了我們關於這份報告明確的指示。)
This movie is not suitable for children because of its explicit content.
(這部電影因為內容露骨，不適合兒童觀看。)

exploit(v./n.)剝削、利用、開發、功績
exploitation(n.)剝削、開發
exploit workers 剝削勞工
exploit natural resources 開發天然資源
Some companies exploit workers by paying them very low wages.
(有些公司以極低的工資剝削勞工。)
We should exploit natural resources in a sustainable way.
(我們應該以永續的方式開發天然資源。)

exploration(n.)探險、探索、勘查
explore(v.)探索
explorer(n.)探險家
space exploration 太空探索
oil exploration 石油探勘
Space exploration has helped us learn more about our own planet.
(太空探索幫助我們更了解自己的星球。)
The children enjoyed their exploration of the forest during summer camp.
(孩子們在夏令營中很享受探索森林的過程。)

extension(n.)延長、擴建、分機
extend(v.)延長
extensive(adj.)廣泛的
extension number 分機號碼
deadline extension 延長期限
Please call me at extension 205 if you have any questions.
(如有任何問題，請撥分機205找我。)
The teacher gave us a one-week extension on the report.
(老師讓我們的報告延後一週繳交。)

extensive(adj.)廣泛的、大量的、廣大的
extend(v.)延伸
extensively(adv.)廣泛地
extensive research 廣泛的研究
extensive damage 大範圍的損害
The scientist did extensive research before publishing her findings.
(這位科學家在發表研究結果前做了廣泛的研究。)
The earthquake caused extensive damage to buildings in the city.
(地震對市區建築造成了大範圍的損害。)

exterior(n./adj.)外部、外表、外部的
interior(n./adj.)內部、內部的
the exterior of 的外觀
exterior wall 外牆
The exterior of the old house was painted bright blue.
(那棟老房子的外觀被漆成亮藍色。)
Workers are repairing the exterior walls of the library.
(工人們正在修繕圖書館的外牆。)

external(adj./n.)外部的、外在的、外表
internal(adj.)內部的
externally(adv.)外部地
external pressure 外部壓力
for external use only 僅供外用
Students often face external pressure from parents and teachers.
(學生常常面臨來自家長和老師的外在壓力。)
This cream is for external use only, so do not swallow it.
(這款藥膏僅供外用，請勿吞食。)
